# K8.6 Packed Q, K, V with the current-scaling amax for FP8 attention

Classification: Internal (becomes public with the MLPerf Training v6.1 results)

[Index](../KERNELS.md) · Switches: `NVFP4_QKV_PACKED=1`, `NVFP4_QKV_PACKED_AMAX=1`
(`config_GB300_2x4x3xtp1pp1cp1ep1_nvfp4_v7.sh` L132-133) · Class: **Bitwise** · Rule basis: TR-8.3

## 1. Packages

G3, G6 and G6b, where named below, are Firmus's earlier GPT-OSS NVFP4 packages (`nemo_g3_nvfp4_v1`, `nemo_g6_nvfp4_v2`,
`nemo_g6b_nvfp4_v2_1`), withdrawn from this submission and no longer in this repository. Their values, line numbers,
images and test jobs are cited as the record of where evidence was collected ([Index](../KERNELS.md), "Earlier packages").

| | G6, G6b, G6c |
|---|---|
| Switches | `NVFP4_QKV_PACKED=1` (L132), `NVFP4_QKV_PACKED_AMAX=1` (L133) |
| Requires | K10.1 (`OPT_QKNORM_ROPE`, the hook is under `_qknorm_rope.ACTIVE`, `pretrain.py` L63); K5.2 is off and its nested hook (L83-87) does not run, K8.1 (`FP8_DPA`) |
| Code | V7 patch `nvfp4_qkv_packed.py` L1725-1951; `firmus_kernels/qknorm_rope_packed.py` (K10.1); `pretrain.py` L62-69 |

Same files in both packages and the same V7 patch in G6c.

## 2. What the reference does

Before FP8 attention (K8.1), TE's `combine_and_quantize` (attention `utils`, upstream) flattens
and concatenates separate sbhd Q, K, V into a new BF16 buffer, and the `Float8CurrentScalingQuantizer`
runs an amax pass over it, computes the scale (`compute_scale_from_amax`) and casts to FP8.

## 3. What this implementation does

1. `install` (L1941-1951) replaces K5.2's `TritonQKVRoPE.forward` with `_packed_forward`
   (L1826-1856) and TE's `combine_and_quantize` (in `utils` and `backends`) with the wrapper
   from `make_combine_and_quantize` (L1890-1938).
2. The forward allocates one buffer and returns Q, K, V as consecutive views of it
   (L1830-1837). With `NVFP4_QKV_PACKED_AMAX=1` the RoPE kernel (L1759-1805, K5.2's arithmetic
   plus L1803-1805) also stores each program's max |output|, recorded in `_last` with the
   buffer's storage pointer (L1840-1846).
3. The wrapper takes the flat view of the three (`packed_flat`, L1859-1871) instead of a concat.
4. If `_last` belongs to this buffer, one program reduces the parts and computes the scale
   (`_amax_scale_kernel`, L1808-1823) and the cast runs through a `Float8Quantizer` with that
   scale (`_quantize_with_parts`, L1874-1887); otherwise the original quantizer runs on the flat
   view (L1924).
G6c: `firmus_kernels/qknorm_rope_packed.py` `install` (L157-166) calls this module's `install` (so step 1 also runs,
and K5.2's class is patched but not used) and routes NVIDIA's fused QK-norm + RoPE to its own forward. That forward
(`packed_fwd`, L108-131; `QKNormRoPEPacked.forward`, L136-145) writes Q, K, V as consecutive views of one buffer
and, with `NVFP4_QKV_PACKED_AMAX=1` (L24), each program's max |output| (L102-105), and records both in this module's
`_last` with the storage pointer (L139-140). Steps 3 and 4 then run unchanged.

## 4. Why the result is the same

The flat view holds exactly the concatenation. Max is exact, and the parts are taken from the
BF16-rounded outputs (K10.1 kernel: `qknorm_rope_packed.py` L88-89, L102-105; V is the input itself, so `|x|` is `|v|`), so the amax equals the amax pass over the
concatenation. The scale follows `compute_scale_from_amax`: `max_fp8 / max(amax, eps)` rounded
to nearest, `inf` → `FLT_MAX`, optional power of two, 1 for amax 0, `inf` or NaN (L1816-1822).
The cast with a given scale is the same TE cast kernel (docstring L1740-1744). Bitwise.

## 5. Numerics

FP32 RoPE arithmetic as K10.1; E4M3 (`max_fp8` 448) or E5M2 (57344) chosen from the quantizer dtype
(L1875).

## 6. Shapes and fallbacks

- **Gate:** layout `sbhd_sbhd_sbhd` or `bshd_bshd_bshd` with no paged KV, a `Float8Quantizer` or
  `Float8CurrentScalingQuantizer` (L1900-1907), and Q, K, V contiguous, same dtype, consecutive
  in one storage (L1859-1871). Amax shortcut: `_last` matches the storage, storage offset 0,
  current-scaling quantizer without amax reduction (L1913-1920).
- **Falls back:** to TE's `combine_and_quantize` (L1908-1911), or to the normal quantizer on the
  packed view (L1924). Counted in `_stats` (L1755); rank 0 prints the counts once, at the 64th
  call (L1894-1899).
- **Assumes:** that no other packed RoPE output is written between the RoPE forward and this
  quantize with the same storage pointer; the match is by pointer only (L1915-1917), and
  `_last` is cleared on use (L1913). The test case `stale_parts_other_output` checks the
  different-storage case. If NVIDIA's QK-norm patch is not active, this switch is ignored without a message
  (`pretrain.py` L63).
- **Check:** config L132-133. In all 10 `results/firmus_gb300_ngpu8_gptoss_g6c_nvfp4_v2_2/gpt_oss_20b/result_*.txt`:
  `NVFP4_QKV_PACKED installed (amax 1)` (L217; with `FIRMUS qknorm_rope packed installed (amax 1)`, L218) and `NVFP4_QKV_PACKED stats {'packed': 64,
  'fallback': 0, 'amax': 64} layout sbhd_sbhd_sbhd ... quantizer Float8CurrentScalingQuantizer`
  (L2276: all 64 calls packed, all 64 with the amax parts of the K10.1 kernel).

## 7. Code

V7 patch `nvfp4_qkv_packed.py` L1725-1951, loaded through `_v7_module` (L338-356) from
`nemo_g6c_nvfp4_v2_2/firmus_kernels/qknorm_rope_packed.py` L162-163 (installed from `pretrain.py` L67-69). Image verify jobs 22541 and 22589 on the G6b image (same patches and `Dockerfile`; not repeated on this image):
`nvfp4_qkv_packed.py == production overlay` (record available on request).

## 8. Tests and evidence

- **On this package's image:** `k8_6_qkv_packed`, job 22882, 35 cases per run: 0 differ except the fixture (largest
  part dropped: 6 of 6 outputs, 9 788 813 elements), including one Inf and one NaN input; run a vs b 302 equal, 0
  differ. This test drives K5.2's packed forward, so it covers steps 3 and 4 (flat view, scale from the parts, cast)
  on this image, not K10.1's forward. K10.1's test (`k10_1_qknorm_rope_packed`) covers the packed layout and the parts;
  the end-to-end path is shown by the stats line of Check. The G6 results follow.
- **Kernel test on the image** (Firmus test script `k8_6_qkv_packed.py`, available on request;
  installed module), job 22434, runs a and b rc 0, 28 cases per run.
  Reference: unpacked K5.2 forward and TE's `combine_and_quantize` with
  an E4M3 current-scaling quantizer. Outputs q, k, v, dqkv, FP8 data and `scale_inv` of q, k,
  v: 0 differ in every case (seeded, captured `linear_qkv` outputs of 7 layers, zero, 1e-30,
  1e30, one Inf, one NaN, finite specials, lengths 1, 7, 8191, 8193, stale parts, unpacked
  inputs, prefill, fresh process). The one case with a difference is the fixture (largest part
  dropped): 6 of 6 outputs, 9 788 813 elements. Run a vs run b: all digests equal (232 for this
  test).
- Earlier jobs 22173, 22399, 22412: 0 differ; path counter packed 1,
  fallback 0 per call.
- **In-run checks, not scored** (job 22171): 64 packed calls, 0 fallbacks.
